nodes.label: HashiCorp Design System (Enterprise Dual-Mode)
nodes.rationale: Design system extraction for HashiCorp website. Key characteristics: dual-mode (white light-mode + dark #15181e hero sections), custom HashiCorp Sans font with 600-700 weights, multi-product color system (Terraform purple, Vault yellow, Waypoint teal, Vagrant blue), token-driven mds component system, micro-shadows at 0.05 opacity.
